pr_body:
Hi @xboxeer ! Hi @roidelapluie ! Hi @sandeep-sen !

This is a first attempt to fix #10942

With the help of the [migration guide](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/blob/main/documentation/MIGRATION_GUIDE.md) and the documentation of the different documentation I'm proposing this solution.

But two things are bothering me. First I add to create a Policy to override the user-Agent. Second, I had to split the Network Interface ID to extract resourceGroupName and networkInterfaceName so I can call the Get method of the NetWorkInterfacesClient.

The second method is specially risky in case of the evolution of the endpoint structure.

Do you have any idea to make this more elegant and maintainable ?


Fixes #10942

Signed-off-by: Matthieu MOREL <matthieu.morel35@gmail.com>

issue_context.title: Move away from deprecated Azure packages.
issue_context.body:
Azure packages have depreciation notices:

**github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/services/compute/mgmt/2018-10-01/compute**
> Please note, this package has been deprecated. A replacement package is available [github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/compute/armcompute](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/compute/armcompute). We strongly encourage you to upgrade to continue receiving updates. See [Migration Guide](https://aka.ms/azsdk/golang/t2/migration) for guidance on upgrading. Refer to our [deprecation policy](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/policies_support.html) for more details.

**github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/services/network/mgmt/2018-10-01/network**
> Please note, this package has been deprecated. A replacement package is available [github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/network/armnetwork](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/network/armnetwork). We strongly encourage you to upgrade to continue receiving updates. See [Migration Guide](https://aka.ms/azsdk/golang/t2/migration) for guidance on upgrading. Refer to our [deprecation policy](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/policies_support.html) for more detail
comments: @roidelapluie I am part of Azure SDK for Go team, I can help you with the migration to our newer sdks, what is the best way to reach you.

If you want to have a look, we only use the azure SDK in one location: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/discovery/azure/azure.go

I could not find the equivalent of the functions we use, e.g. NewVirtualMachinesClientWithBaseURI in the new sdk nor the migration guide.
Adding @xboxeer and @tadelesh for getting onboarding instructions for "track 2" go sdk
Issue https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/issues/18780 raised to optimize migration guidance to include general pattern difference of using SDK

review_comments: As it is not possible do customization of the User-Agent directly, I had to create dedicated Policy do keep the same behavior

Since you only need to add version info of prometheus, you could use `ApplicationID` (in `Telemetry` of `ClientOptions`) to config your application's specific `User-Agent` field. Please refer: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore@v1.3.0/policy#ClientOptions.
Thank you ! I have integrated it and removed the `userAgentPolicy`
